name: @basedloans/mcp
description: MCP server for Based Loans on Base: market data, risk reports, loan quotes and unsigned borrow/lend transactions. Holds no keys.

scripts.build: tsup src/stdio.ts src/http.ts src/server.ts src/fetch.ts --format esm --dts --clean
scripts.build:vercel: esbuild deploy/vercel/src/entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=deploy/vercel/api/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
